verdict.rationale: Attio Workflows is documented as a visual automation builder that runs automated action sequences from triggers such as "When a new deal is created." Steps can include AI agents (Web, Scoring, Routing and Custom) that enrich, score and route records, and users can ask Attio to build workflows from a natural-language goal. SDK docs confirm custom triggers activate when a workflow is enabled and that runs can resume via callbacks, which implies unattended background execution. Missing for 10: first-party product docs on Workflows itself (most evidence is marketing copy), evidence of scheduled or time-based runs, run history and monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
